name: Hilti SLAM Challenge Dataset
summary: 建筑及办公环境的手持多传感器序列，提供时间同步的视觉、LiDAR、IMU 与稀疏高精度位姿真值。
summaryEn: Handheld construction and office sequences with synchronized vision, LiDAR, IMU, and sparse high-accuracy pose ground truth.
scale: Indoor and outdoor construction-oriented sensor sequences
scaleZh: 面向室内外建筑环境的传感器序列
organizations: Hilti AG and University of Zurich
access: Official repository links to datasets and ground truth
accessZh: 官方仓库提供数据和真值下载入口
verdict: 建筑场景多传感器时序
wmNote: 连续传感器流提供观测演化；稀疏真值不应视为每帧都有完整位姿标注。
wmNoteEn: Continuous streams expose observation evolution; sparse truth must not be treated as full per-frame pose annotations.
